name: Hot Pixel Detection
description: Detects hot/dead 像素 patterns absent in AI 图像s
algorithm: Hot Pixel Detection — Sensor/Physical Model Analyzer
mechanism:
Hot pixel detection exploits the unique photo-response non-uniformity (PRNU) of camera sensors:

1. **DarkCurrent映射**: The method identifies pixels with abnormally high dark current values — defective sensor elements ("hot pixels") that produce elevated signal even without light exposure. These form a camera-specific fingerprint per Lukas et al. (2006).

2. **空间模式分析**: Hot pixel locations are mapped across the image. Real camera images exhibit consistent hot pixel patterns determined by the specific sensor hardware. AI-generated images lack these physical sensor defects entirely.

3. **Fixed模式噪声(FPN)提取**: The fixed-pattern noise component is separated from the image signal. Genuine photographs contain deterministic FPN arising from manufacturing variations in photodiodes, while synthetic images show statistically uniform or artificially modeled noise.

4. **时间稳定性验证**: In authentic images, hot pixels appear at fixed spatial locations with intensity dependent on exposure time and sensor temperature (following Arrhenius behavior). The method checks whether detected anomalies conform to these physical constraints.

5. **Authenticity评分**: A confidence score is computed based on the density, spatial distribution, and intensity characteristics of detected hot pixels. Absence of genuine hot pixel signatures or presence of statistically implausible patterns indicates AI generation.
parameters:
分析类型: sensor
媒体: 图像
输入: 原始像素数据 / 图像文件
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
处理方式: 客户端 Canvas API
色彩空间: RGB、灰度（视情况而定）
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-90% 独立准确率. 在未压缩图像上性能最佳 and 在重度JPEG压缩或社交媒体重新编码时可能降低.
source: 数字图像取证研究。基于信号处理和计算摄影原理.
useCase: 通过以下方式检测AI生成或篡改的图像： hot 像素 detection 分析。该方法识别AI生成特有的模式和伪影，为全面的图像取证分析做出贡献.
strengths:
• 使用 Canvas API 快速客户端处理
• 有效检测特定的AI生成伪影
• 支持常见图像格式（JPEG、PNG、WebP）
• 可与互补的分析方法组合使用
• 基于成熟的图像取证研究
limitations:
• 性能可能因图像压缩级别而异
• 社交媒体重新编码可能影响准确性
• 最好与其他取证方法结合使用
• 对经过大量处理的真实图像可能产生误报
• 有效性取决于所使用的AI生成模型

references.title: Lukas, J. et al. (2006). Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Chen, M. et al. (2008). Determining Image Origin and Integrity Using Sensor Noise. IEEE TIFS.
